messages:
esther: Heads-up — sampleapp import started failing after today's SDK release. Looks like the Go SDK generator changed parameter ordering for `CreateWorkspace` (optional config moved before context param).

rana: can you paste the failing import or compile error?

esther: gist of the go build error: 
```
# github.com/redwood/sampleapp/server
./main.go:42:21: undefined: client.CreateWorkspace
// sampleapp calls: client.CreateWorkspace(context.Background(), &opts)
// generated signature now: func CreateWorkspace(opts *CreateWorkspaceOptions, ctx context.Context) error
```
kevin: oof. that's a source-level incompatibility. Was this a deliberate API change?

esther: the release notes show a version bump from 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0, labeled as minor. The typegen diff shows only ordering of optional args, no new endpoints. The comparator flagged it as a "surface change" and bumped minor.

regendiff-bot: regendiff queued (run#4602). Diff: 41 lines. https://ci.internal/regendiff/4602

rana: why did the comparator mark it as minor? optional arg order should be non-breaking in most languages if we emit named params, but our Go SDK uses positional args. Need to tighten comparator logic to be language-aware.

kevin: second issue — CI shows changelog missing: `sdk/CHANGELOG.md` not updated for 1.4.0. Release automation allowed a version bump without changelog entry.

esther: also saw flaky onboarding tests where auth retries were suppressed. In the new release, default `RetryPolicy` went from `DefaultRetries: 2` to `DefaultRetries: 0`. No changelog entry for that either. It looks like two unrelated changes ended up in the same release.

ci-bot: CI artifact: https://ci.internal/builds/78901 — sampleapp integration failed during `go test ./...`

rana: actionable plan: 1) revert the RetryPolicy default in a quick patch release 1.4.1, 2) roll back the positional-arg ordering change and regenerate the Go SDK as patch, 3) update comparator to treat parameter reorder for positional languages as breaking (or enforce named param pattern), 4) add presubmit gating that runs `go build` for canonical sampleapps against generated SDKs and verifies changelog entry for bumped package version.

kevin: will open PRs. I'll create `fix/go-sdk/retain-positional-order` and `hotfix/retry-default`.

esther: opened ticket DEVEX-645 to add presubmit hooks + changelog linter. Also filed TYPEGEN-417 for comparator fix with repro and example diffs.

regendiff-bot: regendiff run results: sampleapp import failure reproduced. https://ci.internal/regendiff/4602/result

kevin: PRs linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1822 (hotfix retry), https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1823 (go generator rollback). CI rerunning now.

rana: long-term: we should surface language-specific contract rules in typegen config. A comparator that treats TypeScript/JS differently from Go/Rust. Also document SDK generator guarantees so release automation understands what changes bump semver.

esther: agree. small doc patch for onboarding: add `go get github.com/redwood-inference/sdk@latest` and a quick `go build` step to catch incompatibilities earlier. I can PR to sampleapp README.

kevin: CI green on hotfix branch for retry revert. Merging and tagging 1.4.1. Publishing patch to package registries.

esther: merging go generator rollback now. After that, we'll re-run regendiff and close TYPEGEN-417 when comparator tests are in place.

rana: thanks everyone. Adding followup items to sprint: comparator fix, presubmit gating, changelog linter, docs update.

esther: closing loop — hotfix published, sampleapp build passes locally. Will monitor for any downstream breakage. :rocket:
